name: gatekeeper
description: API Gateway monorepo with smart gateway, API management, and analytics services

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix smart-gateway-service" "npm run dev --prefix api-management-service" "npm run dev --prefix analytic-service" --names GATEWAY,APIMGMT,ANALYTICS --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix smart-gateway-service && npm run build --prefix api-management-service && npm run build --prefix analytic-service
scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix smart-gateway-service" "npm start --prefix api-management-service" "npm start --prefix analytic-service" --names GATEWAY,APIMGMT,ANALYTICS --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow
scripts.test: npm test --prefix smart-gateway-service && npm test --prefix api-management-service && npm test --prefix analytic-service
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix smart-gateway-service && npm run lint --prefix api-management-service && npm run lint --prefix analytic-service
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix smart-gateway-service && npm run format --prefix api-management-service && npm run format --prefix analytic-service
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix smart-gateway-service && npm install --prefix api-management-service && npm install --prefix analytic-service
